functions.name: cp6CheckWebSockets
functions.notes: Drains pending websocket events through the emscripten asm-const dispatcher selector 22639/operation 5170. Kind 1 calls +48 with (handler,&payload,&word); kinds 2/3 call +24/+72; kind 4 ends the pump and runs the close path (+96) freeing frame+20; kind 0 skips close; other kinds free the payload. Exact payload frees, stack and OOB RuntimeError preserved.

validation.comparison: Eleven scenarios: empty list, no-event socket, two sockets across event kinds 1-5, kind 4 with and without close handler, no-event-with-close skipping close, null-function traps for kinds 1/2/3 and close, malformed socket pointer OOB. Callback dispatch is observed through native counter 604. Each compares outcome/error, complete memory and stack.
limitations: Payload/vtable pointer OOB distinct from the malformed socket pointer is not exercised.
Host dispatcher throwing, cyclic lists and node-next OOB are not exercised.
Ledger: 212 server bodies recovered and 522 remain machine code.
